calls.video_title: Invest....(but where?). Everything is falling: Gold, Nifty, AI Stocks
calls.thesis: Google is a buy-on-dips core stock: down ~10% pre-market to support and ~30% from its peak, forward PE under 18, cheaper than Nifty 50, with the fall driven by AI capex overspend, not a broken business
calls.base_case: Hold a 5-10% portfolio position and add at support levels while fundamentals stay intact
calls.bull_case: AI capex translates into profits and the derating reverses from a sub-18 forward PE
calls.bear_case: Google falls another ~10% from here as AI spending keeps rising without payoff
calls.note: His own action: topping up an already-profitable position. No share price stated, only percentage falls and PE.
